worker_output.summary: Fixed Cloning Technology inconsistencies in planetology.md. The design doc had conflicting information: the §Cloning Technology section correctly described flat +2/+5 pop/turn bonuses, but tier tables, JSON schema, and Formulas Summary section incorrectly showed BC-invested growth model. Now all sections consistently describe flat per-turn bonuses. Also updated code (constants.ts, population.ts) and tests to use correct tech levels (21/42) per the design doc tier tables.

design_compliance.quote: Cloning provides a flat bonus to population growth per turn... +2 pop/turn (TL 21), +5 pop/turn (TL 42)

design_gaps.notes: Bio weapons (Death Spores, Doom Virus, Bio Terminator) have constants and population effects defined, but combat.ts does not integrate them. This is a separate implementation task, not a design doc fix.

notes: fix-25 complete. Cloning tech level and formula inconsistencies resolved. npm run typecheck, npm run test (1497 tests), and npm run check-design all pass.
